record_title: Exact gauge non-identifiability in non-autonomous Moose–Wolf models
provenance: A source-specific structural-identifiability correction for the two non-autonomous prey–predator models in arXiv:2609.20793v1. Explicit gauge transformations show that the three constant interaction parameters can be varied continuously while compensating with the two unknown time-dependent rates and preserving both observed state trajectories exactly.
limitations: The result treats the time-dependent rates as unknown functions in the stated ODE model. It does not establish non-identifiability of a particular fixed finite neural-network architecture considered as part of the parameterization, and it does not assess forecast accuracy or ecological adequacy.
